this_projects_own_measured_evidence.scope_honesty: the measurement was taken on the World Cup 2026 competition (API_FOOTBALL_LEAGUE_ID default 1, season 2026). It is direct evidence that a current season can be silently empty on the free plan. It is NOT direct evidence about MLS/EPL/La Liga/Liga MX, and it is NOT evidence about any PAID plan.
this_projects_own_measured_evidence.the_trap_it_illustrates: the failure mode is HTTP 200 with results:0 - indistinguishable from "nothing is live". A buyer who probes with a fixture that legitimately has no data will read a pass.

assessment.criterion_1: coverage of the four leagues is near-certain (1,200+ leagues claimed); SEASON VISIBILITY on a paid plan is the open question and is exactly what burned this project
assessment.criterion_2: documented endpoints /fixtures/statistics and /fixtures/players exist (secondary evidence). Field list UNVERIFIED.
assessment.criterion_5: a real documented API with published rate limits exists, but the vendor blocks non-browser access to its own docs, which makes contract diligence awkward
assessment.criterion_7: cheapest useful tier plausibly USD 19/mo - by far the cheapest candidate IF its xG turns out to exist for all four leagues
assessment.verdict: the cheapest possible win and the least verifiable candidate. Its correct treatment is a bounded probe, not a purchase decision.
